mechanics.note: A zero-length POST body is sufficient. GET is not required for export once the query string is assembled.

property_reporting_agencies.note: Name-based 2024 coverage report; includes rollups and Not Reporting labels.

violent_reporting_agencies.note: Name-based 2024 coverage report; includes rollups and Not Reporting labels.

property_monthly_incidents.note: Monthly Number of Incidents view for QA only.

violent_monthly_incidents.note: Monthly Number of Incidents view for QA only.

caveats: Use ReportId 105 and 115 for yearly offense totals. The monthly reports 168 and 139 use Number of Incidents and do not reconcile to yearly Number of Crimes totals.
The violent path exposes Non-Consensual Sex Offenses rather than a directly named rape row in the smallest stable export path.

Coverage reports 138 and 167 are name-based and include county rollups, Not Reporting labels, and DO NOT USE-style names elsewhere in the selector. They are useful for QA, not as the primary ORI join source.
Trend tables include partial 2025 and 2026 columns. Central extraction must explicitly select the 2024 column.
The public site notes that violent categories mix victim counts for murder, sex offenses, and aggravated assault with incident counts for robbery.
blockers: Exact rape-only extraction is not confirmed from the smallest stable 2024 table-export path. The confirmed official export surface groups that category as Non-Consensual Sex Offenses.
